recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5509; future VSD alignment changes should be handled through current Vocab trackers rather than this DSTU1 no-action ballot item.
issue_request: FHIR-5509 was a DSTU1 Vocab ballot comment objecting that FHIR should not define resources solely to represent value set definitions and should instead require elements needed to specify a single expansion. It is Published with resolution Considered - No action required; the WG policy was to align with VSD and resolve differences if found.
initial_application: The Jira application comment says an explicit VSD/CLD reference was added in svn revision 5593. Git commit 8c3627f2c2da2a6f21d4ca9b8a9bd68c137936b2 corresponds to that revision and added VSD and Content Logical Definition wording to source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini. The current introduction says ValueSet may carry compose, expansion, both, or metadata only; is used by StructureDefinition, OperationDefinition, Questionnaire, and other resources; and is aligned with VSD with compose as the VSD CLD. Later VSD-family work in FHIR-36015 added detailed ValueSet/VSD guidance, while FHIR-37923 removed the obsolete VSD-aligned profile after newer ValueSet profiles existed. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active ValueSet source already conveys the accepted policy and later VSD guidance refines rather than reverses it.
